presets.output_contract: Structured extraction from supplied context
presets.tier_rationale: Fast. Strict-JSON extraction of contact fields from an already-detected signature block, the same output contract as resolve.rs::extract_opts and voice extract.rs::opts, which pin Haiku. Runs only in the manual backfill-signatures batch (up to --limit 2000 emails). Output is guarded: per-field confidence gates auto-fill (0.7 default), merges are fill-blanks-only, a regex fallback covers parse failures, and low-confidence fields go to a Discord digest. Previously inherited the owner's interactive model (Opus 5 at time of review); now the daemon fast tier (claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 by default, env-overridable via AUGMENTAGENT_MODEL_CLAUDE_FAST).
